data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (converter, holidays, email to ops@example.com with the same subject and body), but it hardcodes "ahead" in the body, adds a "recipient" parameter, and says "Discard or send" when the true workflow requires Discard and never Send, so it is slightly ambiguous on the final step and on the holidays navigation (Calendar > Holidays vs. the Holidays menu).
